# hexcore_images (Data Source)

Read the HexCore images catalog. Results are ordered by slug, then ID where available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hexcore_images" "available" {}

output "images" {
  value = data.hexcore_images.available.images
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) Catalog entries in stable order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Image ID as a string.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Minimum disk size in GB.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Catalog slug.
- `version` (String) Image version text.
